title: Add availability status to Free Stuff posts

requirements.text: Add an `isAvailable` boolean field to the free stuff post data model in the backend, defaulting to `true` for newly created posts. Expose a function to toggle or update availability status for a post.
acceptanceCriteria: The FreeStuffPost type in main.mo includes an `isAvailable` boolean field.
New posts created via `createFreeStuffPost` default `isAvailable` to `true`.
A backend function exists to update the availability status of a free stuff post.

requirements.text: Update `FreeStuffPostCard` to prominently display an availability badge or indicator (e.g., 'Available' in green / 'Unavailable' or 'Expired' in red/gray) based on the `isAvailable` field of each post.
acceptanceCriteria: Each free stuff post card shows a visible 'Available' or 'Unavailable' badge.
The badge styling clearly differentiates available vs. unavailable states using color.
The badge is consistent with the existing Roblox-inspired design system.

requirements.text: Add an 'Available Only' filter toggle to `FreeStuffFeed` so users can filter the list to show only posts where `isAvailable` is `true`.
acceptanceCriteria: A toggle/button labeled 'Available Only' appears in the FreeStuffFeed filter controls.
When active, only posts with `isAvailable: true` are displayed.
The filter integrates with existing category and sort filters without breaking them.

requirements.text: Update `FreeStuffCreationForm` to include an 'Available' checkbox/toggle field that sets the initial `isAvailable` value when creating a new free stuff post.
acceptanceCriteria: The creation form includes an 'Available' toggle that defaults to checked/true.
The value is passed through `useCreateFreeStuffPost` to the backend on submission.

requirements.text: Update `useGetFreeStuffPosts` and `useCreateFreeStuffPost` hooks to pass and receive the `isAvailable` field, and add a new `useUpdateFreeStuffAvailability` mutation hook that calls the backend availability update function.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetched free stuff posts include the `isAvailable` field.
Create mutation passes `isAvailable` to the backend.
A `useUpdateFreeStuffAvailability` hook exists and invalidates the freeStuffPosts cache on success.

constraints: Preserve all existing free stuff post fields and functionality.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Maintain the existing Roblox-inspired design system and color tokens.
nonGoals: Adding a separate 'available items' page — availability is a field on existing free stuff posts.
Real-time availability updates or push notifications.
Allowing non-authors to change availability status.
